newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Shun Cheong shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Shun Cheong shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Shun Cheong Holdings Ltd was suspended on Friday afternoon at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
The company's shares rose HK$0.28 or 29.79 percent to HK$1.22 at midday on volume of 30.21 million shares worth HK$32.85 million.
Shun Cheong said earlier one of its substantial shareholders, Chinney Investments Ltd, was in talks to sell a stake to a Chinese partner.
Chinney holds 18.46 percent of the company.
The other substantial shareholders of Shun Cheong are New World Trading Ltd, which owns 15.47 percent stake, and Yau Lee Holdings Ltd, which holds 15 percent of the company.
